h: About 50 UK peers urge the Home Secretary to bar Macklemore from entering Britain before his Wembley show
p: A group of about 50 peers has written to the Home Secretary asking that the rapper be stopped from entering the UK ahead of his London concert. There has been no decision reported yet.
more: The concert at Wembley is still scheduled.
The singer's team has not yet been reported to have responded.
